verses.text: So I, a prisoner in the Lord, urge you to live in a way worthy of the calling you received.
Be humble and gentle, patient, and put up with one another in love.
Make every effort to preserve the unity the Spirit gives, held together by peace.
There is one body and one Spirit, just as you were called to one hope.
There is one Lord, one faith, one baptism,
one God and Father of all, who is over all, works through all, and lives in all.
But each of us has received grace according to the measure Christ has given.
That's why Scripture says, ‘When he went up on high, he led captives in his train and gave gifts to people.’
What does ‘he went up’ mean except that he also came down to the lower regions of the earth?
The one who came down is also the one who went up far above all the heavens, so he could fill everything.
Christ gave some to be apostles, some prophets, some evangelists, and some pastors and teachers,
to equip God's people for serving and to build up Christ's body,
until we all reach unity in faith and in knowing God's Son, becoming mature and reaching the full measure of Christ.
Then we won't be children anymore, tossed around by waves and carried here and there by every new teaching, tricked by people and their schemes.
Instead, speaking the truth in love, we'll grow in every way into Christ, who is the head.
From him the whole body is joined and held together by every supporting ligament. As each part does its work, the body grows and builds itself up in love.
So I tell you this, and insist on it in the Lord: don't live anymore as the Gentiles do, with their empty thinking.
Their understanding is darkened. They are separated from God's life because of the ignorance in them and the hardening of their hearts.
They've become numb and given themselves over to reckless behavior, pursuing every kind of impurity and greed.
But that's not how you learned Christ,
if indeed you heard about him and were taught in him, as the truth is in Jesus.
You were taught to take off your old self, which belongs to your former way of life and is being ruined by deceptive desires,
to be renewed in the spirit of your minds,
and to put on the new self, created to be like God in true righteousness and holiness.
So stop lying. Each of you should tell the truth to your neighbor, because we're all parts of one another.
‘Be angry, but don't sin.’ Don't let the sun go down while you're still angry,
and don't give the devil an opening.
If you used to steal, stop stealing. Instead, work hard and do something useful with your hands, so you can share with anyone in need.
Don't let harmful talk come out of your mouth. Say only what is helpful for building others up, as the moment calls for, so your words can give grace to those who hear.
Don't grieve God's Holy Spirit, who marked you as his own for the day of redemption.
Get rid of all bitterness, rage, anger, shouting, slander, and every kind of malice.
Be kind and compassionate to one another, forgiving each other just as God forgave you in Christ.
